title: Core Septet #32
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, seven women in a single row.

A photograph of SEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 7 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[manba / Curved Bust]: Japanese woman, early 40s, demure and soft, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long bleached platinum hair with a neon streak, a fierce, playful expression, curly hair, square nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Shoes: extreme cobalt-and-ochre extreme platform clear heels.

[folk-portrait / Legend Bust]: Ukrainian woman, early 20s, cool and composed, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, long light-brown hair in a thick braid over one shoulder, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, elegant updo hair, square nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward. Shoes: extreme silver platform stiletto Mary Janes.

[Lebanese Wedding Glam / Legend Bust]: Lebanese woman, mid 40s, cheerful, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, twin-tail hair, round nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme silver chrome platform stiletto corset-lace boots.

[decora / Muscle Hourglass]: Japanese woman, late 20s, cool and composed, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, long pastel rainbow hair in twin tails crowded with colourful plastic clips, ribbons and tiny toys kept on the hair, a bright, giddy grin, high ponytail hair, square nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip. Shoes: extreme gold-leaf platform stiletto heels.

[Jamaican Dancehall Glam / Polynesian Goddess]: Jamaican woman, late 50s, sultry, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, low bun hair, almond nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame. Shoes: extreme gold thigh-high stiletto boots.

[Balkan glam / Legend Bust]: Romanian woman, mid 40s, bold and confident, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, long dark-brown hair in glossy voluminous waves, an intense, proud expression, low bun hair, stiletto nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward. Shoes: extreme gold-and-crimson platform stiletto peep-toe heels.

[Persian Glam / Powerlifter]: Iranian woman, mid 30s, demure and soft, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, braided hair, coffin nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto knee-high boots.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 7, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
